scripts.dev:worker: bun run wrangler:config --local && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run wrangler:config
scripts.types:worker: bun run wrangler:config --local && wrangler types worker/worker-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate: bun run wrangler:config && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: bun run wrangler:config --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --local
scripts.deploy: bun run wrangler:config && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
